newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia's PUMA sees tighter margins ahead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia's PUMA sees tighter margins ahead.

text.p: Macquarie Bank's securitisation vehicle, PUMA Management Ltd, expects its securities to fetch a further tightening in margins once its Eurobond programme gets underway.
Earlier, PUMA announced that its latest Series B A$500 million bonds were priced 21.3 basis points over 90-day bank bill swap rate, the lowest margin of any domestic mortgage-backed issue to date.
"The outlook for our cost of funds is positive and we expect to see further tightening of our margins once our Eurobond programme commences," said Tony Gill, PUMA's managing director.

"We are continuing to work on PUMA's Eurobond programme and we hope to make an announcement of our plans to issue offshore as soon as the Withholding Tax legistration is enacted," Gill added, announcing today's bond pricing, which was earlier than expected due to strong demand for the securities.
